jobPostingInfo.title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer - Electrical Systems
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
Company

ALPINE RACING LIMITED

Job Description

Are you ready to accelerate your career with a dynamic and innovative F1 team? We have a fantastic opportunity for an exceptionally talented Mechanical Design Engineer specialised in Electrical Systems Integration to join our Electronics group within the Engineering Office at Enstone. This position will play a crucial role in helping us push for podiums and race wins. 

Our team is dedicated to engineering excellence, pushing the boundaries of technology and optimising performance to achieve our goals. We are built on collaboration and mutual support, fostering a vibrant, inclusive culture where your ideas and contributions are valued.


As a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer - Electrical Systems Integration, you will be responsible for the mechanical design and integration of electrical systems both on and off the car. 

This is far more than component packaging. You'll be solving complex design challenges that balance performance, reliability, manufacturability and serviceability within the extreme constraints of a Formula One car. 

Key responsibilities include: 

  • 3D design and integration of electrical systems across the entire vehicle. 
  • Design of composite and metallic components that support and protect critical electrical hardware. 
  • Development and routing of complex wiring harnesses through highly packaged environments. 
  • Creation of innovative installation concepts that optimise weight, stiffness, accessibility and performance. 
  • Production of detailed engineering drawings and documentation to support manufacture and assembly. 
  • Collaboration with Electronics, Vehicle Design, Aerodynamics and Production departments to deliver integrated engineering solutions. 
  • Supporting future car programmes and the development of new technologies, materials and engineering approaches. 

You'll see your designs progress rapidly from concept to track, with opportunities to influence race car performance throughout the season

Who we want:

We are looking to enhance our talented team with someone who has previous experience, ideally within F1 or another high-level motorsport. You should be educated to degree level or equivalent in Mechanical Engineering and have a solid base knowledge of engineering first principles. 

Previous CAD experience is essential. Ideally with Catia V5/3DX and knowledge of Electrical Workbench, but we will support with training if NX or similar is your expertise. A good understanding of motorsport electrical systems is beneficial with solid knowledge of military spec connectors and harness design.  

We need someone who is self-motivated, analytical, and a pragmatic decision-maker capable of working with minimal supervision. We seek someone with a creative, innovative, and consistent approach to problem-solving. 

What we offer you in return:

Working for Alpine F1 Team, you will work with top professionals, directly impacting race car performance on a global stage, and enjoy our state-of-the-art facilities. We offer competitive remuneration packages, private medical healthcare, access to a free on-site gym, a subsidised restaurant and many more additional benefits. Additionally, the thrill of pioneering innovation in Formula One racing provides numerous career development opportunities in a collaborative, inclusive environment.

At Alpine F1 Team, we celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone can be their true selves. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, ethnicities, cultures, and experiences. We are committed to leading by example in promoting diversity, inclusion, and belonging in our society.
